name: typical
query: An import fails only on empty files. Existing logs show a parsing exception. Explain the investigation before editing.
expected_behavior: Tests a specific explanation against evidence

name: edge
query: A bug occurs only in a remote environment you cannot access. Local attempts do not reproduce it.
expected_behavior: Requests the minimum missing evidence or access
Does not claim a confirmed cause

name: failure
query: A CI job fails because its registry endpoint cannot resolve. A proposed fix deletes the failing test and retries the whole pipeline.
expected_behavior: Identifies an environment or dependency problem
Avoids an unchanged blind retry loop
